==================
set with compound assignment operators
==================

sub vcl_backend_response {
    set beresp.ttl = 1s;
    set beresp.ttl += 1s;
    set beresp.ttl -= 1s;
    set beresp.ttl *= 2;
    set beresp.ttl /= 2;
}

---

(source_file
  (toplev_declaration
    (sub_declaration
      (ident)
      (block
        (stmt
          (set_stmt
            (nested_ident)
            (literal
              (duration
                (number)
                (duration_unit)))))
        (stmt
          (set_stmt
            (nested_ident)
            (literal
              (duration
                (number)
                (duration_unit)))))
        (stmt
          (set_stmt
            (nested_ident)
            (literal
              (duration
                (number)
                (duration_unit)))))
        (stmt
          (set_stmt
            (nested_ident)
            (literal
              (number))))
        (stmt
          (set_stmt
            (nested_ident)
            (literal
              (number))))))))
